//: The test suite is typechecked separately from the product, and this file is the whole reason. See docs/decisions/0005-tests-are-not-indexed-code.md.
//2: `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` is ON for src/ and OFF here. The flag earns its keep in product code, where `results[results.length - 1]` really can be undefined at runtime. In a test it fires almost exclusively on `expect(rows[0].name)`, where the assertion itself is the proof that the element exists — turning those into non-null assertions would add 70-odd `!` characters that assert nothing the following line does not already assert. The flag stays ON for src/, where a missing element is a real crash.
